thread:
incident-bot: PAGER: high p99 tail latency observed for streaming endpoints in eu-west2 starting ~2305123420, paging oncall (severity: S2).

maria_ops: I see streaming p95 ~220ms but p99 jumped to 3.8s across several clusters, alerts from trace sampling. user-facing retries increasing.

daniel_oncall: I'm on it, joining. first check: is this a model/container CPU spike or network?

sara_net: +1 to network suspicion — telemetry shows increased TCP handshake time and TLS SYN retransmits on egress NATs in eu-west2-a/b. Packet loss counters spiked on egress path.

katie_sre: any customer-facing errors reported? sam_support, can you confirm?

sam_support: CS reported 2 medium customers with streaming freezes and websocket reconnects. Tickets created: #CS-4521, #CS-4522. They're seeing stalls mid-response.

maria_ops: Running quick `ss -tanp` on a few boxes, seeing many sockets in SYN-SENT and some in CLOSE_WAIT. NAT ephemeral ports exhaustion?

sara_net: Checking NAT metrics... ephemeral_port_in_use ratio hit 0.94 on the nat-gw cluster for eu-west2. Also seeing inter-AZ routing flaps between eu-west2-b -> eu-west2-c.

infra-bot: Deployed nat-gw autoscale policy: desired=12 -> 18 (triggered).

katie_sre: Can we route traffic away from the most impacted AZ while we investigate? Suggest temporary LB weight shift for streaming-critical routes.

daniel_oncall: I'll do an emergency route adjustment for streaming-api-prod: reduce weight in eu-west2-b to 10% and increase eu-west2-c/d to absorb. Performing now.

maria_ops: Command used:
```
# adjust weights
redwood-cli lb update --route streaming-api-prod --set-weight eu-west2-b=10,eu-west2-c=45,eu-west2-d=45
```

maria_ops: Observability: p99 starting to come down to ~1.6s within 3m of reroute. Some customers still seeing stalls, likely due to in-flight connections stuck on the old path.

sara_net: We're seeing TLS handshake spikes at the NAT egress - retransmit rate high. Packet captures show repeated SYN retries with different initial TTLs, looks like cross-AZ asymmetric path or MTU causing fragmentation and retransmits.

katie_sre: Is there any recent config push to route tables or a mesh update? Change windows?

sara_net: No config pushes in window. Cloud provider reports noisy hardware on one ToR in eu-west2-b causing intermittent drops. They're replacing the NIC. We can mitigate by draining the AZ for new connections.

incident-bot: NOTE: oncall handoff scheduled in 20m. Current pager owner: daniel_oncall.

sam_support: Customer impact note for CS: "We observed elevated tail latency and streaming stalls in eu-west2 between ~11:30–11:55 UTC. We've mitigated by shifting traffic and scaling NAT capacity; detailed follow-up will be provided."

maria_ops: Temporary mitigation checklist executed:
- shifted LB weights away from impacted AZ
- scaled NAT gateway pool + added ephemeral port range
- bumped nat-gw replicas (done)
- disabled cross-AZ hairpin routing for streaming route (temporary)

Commands used for NAT port increase:
```
# expand ephemeral range
redwood-netctl nat update --region eu-west2 --ephemeral-range 32768-61000
```

sara_net: After port range expansion and nat-gw scaling, ephemeral_in_use dropped to 0.62 and TLS handshake RTOs reduced. p99 stabilized ~420ms after full rollout.

daniel_oncall: Next steps: continue monitoring for 30m, validate no regressions in other regions, open follow-up action items (postmortem + infra change to prevent ToR single point). I'll start the incident timeline.

katie_sre: Assigning owners: network root cause -> sara_net, infra durability -> maria_ops, customer comms -> sam_support.

incident-bot: Playbook link: <https://internal.playbooks.redwood/incidents/network-egress-handshake|network-egress-handshake>

maria_ops: Quick note — remember to capture tcpdump from a problematic host before we lose state. Example filter used:
```
tcpdump -i eth0 -s 0 -w /tmp/euw2-syns.pcap 'tcp[tcpflags] & (tcp-syn) != 0'
```

sara_net: Uploaded pcap to /var/artifacts/2305123456-eu-pcap.pcap for postmortem. Initial analysis: SYNs to external endpoints see retransmit ~3x before completion, sequence of ICMP fragmentation seen toward one egress hop.

sam_support: CS updated customers with the temporary mitigation note; next update scheduled in 1h or on resolution.

katie_sre: If cloud provider confirms ToR firmware/hardware issue, we should add an automatic multi-AZ shift for streaming routes when packet loss > x% for > y minutes. Add to Optimize later.

daniel_oncall: Closing active paging for severity S2; keep watch. Will transition to incident review channel in 1h. Thanks team. :heart:

incident-bot: Incident status changed to mitigated (S2 -> monitoring).
